verdict.rationale: llamafile runs models entirely on the user's device with no cloud or data sharing, and its server sandbox blocks outbound connections, so user data cannot leave the machine to be used for training. A community user also observed it running with zero network connection. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for model training, and independent verification of the network sandbox beyond one anecdote.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Models run entirely on your device. No cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies. Works fully offline for privacy-first AI workflows.
No outbound network. `anet` allows `accept()` but not `connect()`, so the only networking the server can do is answer connections it received.
Run local LLMs privately, offline, and with full control over compute, data, and cost.
It appears to execute with zero network connection
